H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H1272: to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly
H8659: Tarshish, a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H7939: payment of contract; concretely, salary, fare, maintenance; by implication, compensation, benefit
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H2904: to pitch over or reel; hence (transitively) to cast down or out
H7307: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H2803: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H2199: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3627: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H7043: to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.)
H3411: properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess
H5600: a (sea-going) vessel (as ceiled with a deck)
H7901: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
H7290: to stun, i.e. stupefy (with sleep or death)
H7126: to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H6245: probably to be sleek, i.e. glossy; hence (through the idea of polishing) to excogitate (as if forming in the mind)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H1486: properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot)
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H4399: properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor)
H370: where? (only in connection with prepositional prefix, whence)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H5680: an Eberite (i.e. Hebrew) or descendant of Eber
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H5590: to rush upon; by implication, to toss (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative)
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H2864: to force a passage, as by burglary; figuratively, with oars
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H3201: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H1818: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
H2654: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H2076: to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice)
H2077: properly, a slaughter, i.e. the flesh of an animal; by implication, a sacrifice (the victim or the act)
H5087: to promise (pos., to do or give something to God)
H5088: a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised
H4487: properly, to weigh out; by implication, to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll
H1104: to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy
H4578: used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively, sympathy; by implication, a vest; by extension the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
